Class EventCard

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.Card
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.EventCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EventCard extends Card
Representation of an Event Card.
This Class works as the representation for an Event Card, independently of its Event.

      public EventCard(int era, int id, IF_Event event)
      Constructor of an Event Card.
      Pre: 1 <= era <= 4 && id > 1 && event != null
      Post: this.era = era && this.id = id && this.event = event
      Parameters:
      era - Era when the Card is draw.
      id - Unique ID of the Card.
      event - Event assigned to the Card.
